summary.text: Anne-Marie Mastraccio, a Democrat, represents House District 142 (Sanford and Springvale, York County) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Sanford. The House profile lists service as chair of the Government Oversight Committee and membership on the Health Coverage, Insurance and Financial Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 126th, 127th, 128th, 129th, 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives legislator as the occupation.
It says Mastraccio is married, to Al, with two children and three grandchildren.
